description: Send a test SMS to a phone number. This delivers a real text message and consumes SMS credits from the workspace's existing balance based on destination, message segments, and media; it never purchases credits or changes the plan. Intended for user-requested test sends. Requires the SMS add-on with a verified number (see get_sms_settings). Limited to 100 test sends per company per rolling 24 hours; bypasses quiet hours; excluded from step stats. Each successful call sends another text, so after a timeout check with the user before retrying.

blocks.description: SMS content blocks (text + image subset). Provide text or blocks, not both.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

fromNumberId.description: Active SMS number ID to send from (see get_sms_settings). Defaults to the company's oldest active number - the same default real sends use.

imageUrls.description: Up to 2 publicly reachable image URLs sent as MMS media (US/CA only).

text.description: Plain-text message body. Merge tags are not resolved for test sends to arbitrary numbers. Provide text or blocks.

to.description: Destination phone number in international E.164 format, e.g. +15550100123.

name: send_test_sms

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `send_test_sms` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
